releaseNotes: Adds optional Firebase-backed Android announcements with S branding and explicit opt-in. Adds the user's Tiny Pop Samsung UK stream as the preferred source while preserving alternate streams and the real logo. Expands available now/next guide support to ZA, IN, GB, US, DE, FR, AU and ES; displays No Data instead of fabricated titles when listings are unavailable. Retains SAST sports times and year-ahead team/league search where data exists. KIX is not included because redistribution permission for the supplied restream is unverified. The v1.2.0 popup says PUSH NOTIFICATIONS ADDED 🔥 without a KIX claim. Remote announcements reach only opted-in v1.2.0+ devices; none are registered yet, so no broadcast has been sent.
